newsitem.title: CHILE: Foreign investment up sharply in Chile Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment up sharply in Chile Jan-Aug.

text.p: New foreign investment in Chile totalled $4.01 billion in the first eight months of this year, up 38 percent from the same period of 1995, the Economy Ministry reported.
Of that total, direct investment under Law 600 accounted for $2.8 billion, $970 million were through placement of American Depositary Receipts and the rest through other means, the ministry said.
New foreign investment included the purchase of seven percent of Embotelladora Andina by Bottling Investment, said the ministry.
It was not immediately clear whether Bottling Investment represented some other company in the purchase.

Andina will use proceeds from the purchase for a new bottling plant in Cordoba, Argentina, and for a plastic container plant in Buenos Aires, said the ministry's Foreign Investment Committee chief Eduardo Moyano.
